description: This Java class 'AlarmCalculatedFieldState' manages the state and logic for alarm calculation within the Thingsboard platform. It handles alarm creation, updates, evaluation of alarm conditions, and alarm actions, integrating with alarm services and maintaining alarm rules and current alarm status.

classes.name: AlarmCalculatedFieldState
classes.description: Manages alarm state, evaluation, creation, and clearing logic within the Thingsboard platform, extending BaseCalculatedFieldState.

methods.name: setCtx
methods.description: Initializes context, configuration, and alarm rules based on the provided CalculatedFieldCtx and actor reference.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the alarm state, restoring previous state if applicable, and schedules reevaluation if needed.

methods.name: initRuleState
methods.description: Creates or restores an AlarmRuleState for a given severity and rule, marking re-evaluation needed if conditions require.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the alarm configuration state.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Clears all rule states and the current alarm, closing the alarm state.

methods.name: performCalculation
methods.description: Performs alarm evaluation based on updated arguments and schedules reevaluation if necessary, returning the calculation result.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates argument entries, adjusting timestamps if needed, and calls superclass method.

methods.name: processAlarmAction
methods.description: Processes alarm actions such as acknowledge, clear, or delete.

methods.name: processAlarmClear
methods.description: Clears the current alarm and resets rule states.

methods.name: processAlarmAck
methods.description: Acknowledges the current alarm.

methods.name: processAlarmDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current alarm, effectively clearing it.

methods.name: createOrClearAlarms
methods.description: Evaluates alarm rules to create or clear alarms based on alarm conditions.

methods.name: clearState
methods.description: Clears a given alarm rule state.

methods.name: initCurrentAlarm
methods.description: Fetches the latest active alarm if not already fetched.

methods.name: calculateAlarmResult
methods.description: Creates or updates an alarm based on evaluation results and current alarm state.

methods.name: createDetails
methods.description: Generates alarm details JSON, replacing placeholders with argument values.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates an alarm condition expression, supporting Tbel and simple expressions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a filter predicate against an argument entry.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a key filter predicate.

methods.name: evalComplexPredicate
methods.description: Evaluates a complex filter predicate with AND/OR logic.

methods.name: evalBooleanPredicate
methods.description: Evaluates a boolean filter predicate.

methods.name: evalNumPredicate
methods.description: Evaluates a numeric filter predicate.

methods.name: evalStrPredicate
methods.description: Evaluates a string filter predicate.

methods.name: evalNoDataPredicate
methods.description: Evaluates a no-data filter predicate based on elapsed time.

methods.name: resolveValue
methods.description: Resolves static or dynamic values for alarm condition evaluation.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Retrieves argument entry by key, throwing if missing.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves alarm configuration from context.

methods.name: validateNewEntry
methods.description: Validates that argument entries are of supported type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the calculated field type, which is ALARM.
